_note: Audience-opinion codebook (Stage 4.7). Multi-label: every code is marked for every item. Used by `ss sentiment`. 0.1 was the audit draft; 0.2 adds the Stage 4.7 review clarifications.
unit: one public comment, reply or post (split into clauses only when parts clearly have different targets)
rules: Read the whole text before marking absent; partial or truncated text means uncertain.
Emoji-only, sarcasm and ambiguous irony are uncertain unless the context settles them; never default them to positive.
Never record usernames, handles or profile details, and never infer age, gender, nationality, location or any protected attribute.
Commenters are a self-selected group: a sample describes what some commenters wrote, not what viewers think.
Spanish expressions such as 'es cine', 'me muero', 'qué cringe', 'ya otro más', 'no puede ser' change meaning with context: mark uncertain when the context does not settle them.
Code the text you were given; do not look up the commenter.

stance.about: overall valence of the item, separate from the codes

language.about: language as observed in the text; not the commenter's country

play_intent_subtype.about: only when PLAY_INTENT is present; 'what game is this?' is information_request, not intent

codes.definition: Positive judgement of the content, craft or idea.
Negative judgement of the content, craft or idea.
codes.boundary: Repetition complaints are FATIGUE; forced tone is CRINGE; both can co-occur with CRITICISM.

codes.definition: Repetition or exhaustion of a format, sound or trend: 'not again', 'every video is this now', 'this trend is dead', 'otra vez lo mismo', 'ya cansa'.
codes.boundary: Needs a repetition or exhaustion context; disliking one video is CRITICISM.

codes.definition: Perceived forced or out-of-touch execution: try-hard slang, brands or adults misusing a meme, 'cringe', 'lache', 'qué cringe'.
Suspicion or assertion that content is AI-made, fake or misrepresented gameplay: 'AI slop', 'is this real?', 'fake gameplay', 'hecho con IA'.
codes.boundary: Record ai_authenticity_mode: suspicion (a question or hedge) vs assertion.

codes.definition: Explicit preference for an earlier version of the format, creator or trend: 'the old ones were better', 'era mejor antes'.
codes.boundary: Childhood-show nostalgia without a format comparison is not this code.

codes.definition: An identifiable request for different or new content: 'do one where…', 'haz uno de…'.
codes.boundary: A bare 'part 2' with no alternative named is not REQUEST_ALT.

codes.definition: Laughter or praise for the joke, including ironic forms ('I hate that I laughed', 'jajaja', 'me muero').
codes.boundary: Set irony; emoji-only laughter is uncertain unless context confirms it.

codes.definition: Interest in finding, the release of, or playing the game.
codes.boundary: Record play_intent_subtype; only expressed_play_intent states a wish to play.

codes.definition: Disputes the premise, the video or another commenter.
codes.boundary: Target other_commenter when replying to a person.

codes.definition: The item actually subverts or parodies the format, or explicitly suggests a parody or counter-version.
codes.boundary: Mentioning the format is not enough.
